tagline: Real acoustic drum kit, every piece on its own key
description: Multi-mic recordings of two real drum kits (close, overhead and room mics), played back with velocity layers and round robin so every hit sounds different. Click any piece of the drawn kit to hear it, swap its sound or move its key; record the whole kit into one piano roll.
highlights: Kick, snare with sidestick, hi-hat (closed, half-open, open, pedal), 3 toms, 2 crashes, ride with bell, china
Swap any piece for another recorded sound of its kind, including a full brushes kit
Close, overhead and room mics per piece and for the whole kit, plus tune, decay, glue and width
Kit-bus Drive (8 distortion types), bit Crush and Tone, for anything from warm tape to broken industrial
General MIDI key map shown in FL Studio note names; re-learn any key from your keyboard
52 kit presets: studio, live room, vintage and jazz, tight funk and soul, big rooms, Yeezus, moshc0re, KING, trip hop, 80s and 2000s
installTips: The .pkg also installs the drum sound library (about 230 MB). With the .zip, Install.command copies it for you.
Keys (FL names): kick C3, snare D3, sidestick C#3, closed hat F#3, pedal hat G#3, open hat A#3, toms C4 / A3 / G3, crashes C#4 / A4, ride D#4, bell F4, china E4.
previewNote: on the same five-bar 96 BPM groove: ghost notes, open hat, a ride bar, a tom fill and crashes ringing out.

items: 2000s category, 6 new kits: the Neptunes' dry knock, Timbaland's bounce, Dr. Dre's heavy West Coast drums, a Kanye-style dusty soul break, N.E.R.D.'s live rock band and a crunk stadium kit (extreme)

80s category, 6 new kits: the gated drum break of In The Air Tonight, a gated arena snare, an I'm Still Standing pop-rock kit, a dry Moroder disco kit, a drum-machine-era crunch (extreme) and a power-ballad kit (subtle)

New look, matching the rawleads instrument design: a DARK / LITE switch in the top bar (every open plugin follows it, with a soft crossfade), keycap buttons that press in, the preset name on a lit smoked-amber key with a flickering lamp behind it, LED switches, glowing knob arcs, console displays and the Instrument Sans typeface
